_comment: Single source of truth for all third-party library versions. Pinned as of 2026-08-03. Do NOT bump without updating ARCHITECTURE.md and re-testing.
_loadingStrategy: three.js and cannon-es are ESM-only and are loaded via the importmap in index.html (bare specifiers 'three', 'three/addons/*', 'cannon-es'). howler, gsap, and localforage ship UMD builds and are loaded as classic <script> tags that expose globals.

three.purpose: 3D rendering, scene graph, PBR materials, post-processing

cannon-es._note: 0.20.0 ships ESM-only (no UMD build). Must be loaded via importmap, not <script src>.
cannon-es.purpose: Rigid-body physics, raycast vehicle, collision detection

howler.purpose: Audio playback, bus routing, positional audio

gsap.purpose: Tweening engine for UI transitions, cutscenes, micro-animations

localforage.purpose: IndexedDB-backed persistence for save data, settings, progression

_fallbackStrategy: If jsdelivr is unreachable, swap to unpkg.com by replacing 'cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm' with 'unpkg.com'. Versions stay pinned. Update both the importmap in index.html AND the umdUrl/esmUrl fields here.
